indicators: Only on Cursor's extension marketplace; the Open VSX and Microsoft Marketplace builds were not affected
Planted an SSH key labelled svc-telemetry in the user's authorized keys
Opened a reverse SSH tunnel to 134.209.82.225
summary: Builds 2.1.312 and 2.1.313 of the Claude Code extension on Cursor's extension marketplace were tampered with to install a persistent SSH backdoor on developer machines. The genuine extension id was used; Anthropic's own systems were not compromised.
remediation: In Cursor, check the installed Claude Code extension version. If 2.1.312 or 2.1.313 was installed on 29 October 2026, update to 2.1.314 or later, remove unknown keys from ~/.ssh/authorized_keys (look for svc-telemetry), and rotate the SSH keys and credentials stored on that machine.

sources.title: Security notice: malicious version of Anthropic.claude-code (2.1.312 and 2.1.313) in the Cursor VS Code Extension Marketplace
